Name: FireCompassRisks
Author: FireCompass - support@firecompass.com
Description: The **FireCompass Risks** solution provides a Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) data connector that pulls risk findings from the FireCompass platform REST API into Microsoft Sentinel. Risk records are ingested into the FCRisks_CL custom table for analysis, correlation with endpoint telemetry, and closed-loop remediation.
